prompt: Reductive amination: benzaldehyde + methylamine + NaBH₃CN. Draw the product.

traps.note: The imine is the intermediate; NaBH3CN reduces it to the 2° amine.

explanation: Amine + aldehyde form an iminium ion in situ; NaBH₃CN selectively reduces iminium (not aldehyde) at mildly acidic pH → secondary amine.
